'''Green Squadron''', alternatively known as '''Green Group''' or '''Green Wing''', was the name of a number of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] that served the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] throughout the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
===Battle of Yavin===
The [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] provided cover for [[Blue Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Blue Squadron]] during the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]<ref name="The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia">{{CSWECite|I|367|Green Squadron (1)}}</ref> in an attack run on the [[Superlaser/Legends|superlaser]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]], aiming to disable the weapon and distract Imperial forces from a simultaneous attack on the [[Space station/Legends|station's]] [[Thermal exhaust port/Legends|exhaust port]].<ref name="TEGW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

===Endor===
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a group of Green Squadron's [[BTL-S3 Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL-S3 Y-wing starfighters]] conducted raids on elements of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] in the [[Endor system/Legends|Endor system]]. After a successful mission, [[Havoc Squadron]] was dispatched to cover the retreat of Green Squadron.<ref name="SWG:AGSiatE" />

===Battle of Hoth===
During the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], members from the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion's]] Green and Blue Squadrons and [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Flight]] were cobbled together and pressed into service as a unified "Rogue Squadron," doubling up as [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] and [[Gunner/Legends|gunners]] aboard the Rebels' [[Snowspeeder/Legends|snowspeeders]].<ref name="TEGW" /> The remaining Blues and Greens either piloted evacuating transports or their fighter escorts during the battle.<ref name="X-wing Alliance" /><ref name="RoguesGallery146">{{InsiderCite|146|Rogues Gallery|Rogues Gallery: Clearance for Immediate Launch}}</ref>

[[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]] pilots designated with the [[Callsign/Legends|call signs]] "[[Green Leader/Legends|Green Leader]]" and "[[Green Two/Legends|Green Two]]" escorted the ''[[Otana/Legends|Otana]]'', the [[YT-2000 light freighter/Legends|YT-2000 light freighter]] of the [[Azzameen family]] of Rebel-allied [[Merchant/Legends|traders]], as it fled from Imperial forces on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. While a pair of orbiting [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyers]] were disabled by a Rebel [[V-150 Planet Defender/Legends|ion cannon]], the [[Green Leader (Battle of Hoth)|squadron leader]] and [[Green Two (Battle of Hoth)|wing]] fought off [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighter]] pursuit, allowing the Azzameens to escape into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].<ref name="X-wing Alliance" />

*Green Leader - Unknown pilot<ref name="X-wing Alliance" />
*Green Two - Unknown pilot<ref name="X-wing Alliance" />
*[[Green Three/Legends|Green Three]] - [[Adam Swiftgale]]<ref name="RoguesGallery146" />
*[[Green Four/Legends|Green Four]] - [[Nichos Panib]]<ref name="RoguesGallery146" />
*[[Green Five/Legends|Green Five]] - [[Habeer Zignean]]<ref name="RoguesGallery146" />

===Aboard ''Defiance''===
After the Battle of Hoth, a Green Group of [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel pilots]] was stationed aboard the [[MC80A Home One Type Heavy Star Cruiser/Legends|MC80 ''Home One'' type Star Cruiser]] [[Defiance/Legends|''Defiance'']], including Green Five [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Olin Garn]], an X-wing pilot who worked with the Azzameen family to procure healing [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] for a [[Hospital (XQ2 Platform)|secret Rebel hospital]], and [[Green Seven/Legends|Green Seven]] [[Jorgis]], a rookie pilot who was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in action.<ref name="X-wing Alliance" />

Green Group employed the use of [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighters]] in a [[Destruction of the Scythe convoy|raid]] on the Imperial [[Convoy/Legends|convoy]] ''[[Veltnor]]'',<ref name="X-wing Alliance" /> which successfully destroyed the force at the cost of one<ref name="XWASG">[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref> of four Y-wings. Later, a nine&ndash;Y-wing element of the group was tasked with [[Rescue at Bundil II|disabling]] ''[[VTR-LX]]'', a [[Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Dreadnaught''-class heavy cruiser]] carrying Rebels taken [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]] at Hoth.<ref name="X-wing Alliance" />

Green Group adopted [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|A/SF-01 B-wing starfighters]] for a four&ndash;[[Starship/Legends|ship]] [[Battle of Bettel|strike]] at the [[Corrupter repair convoy|Imperial repair team]] borne by the [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] [[Monitor (EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate)|''Monitor'']], during which it was joined by Azzameen family member [[Ace Azzameen/Legends|Ace Azzameen]] as Green Two. Six Green Group B-wings would subsequently be deployed to [[Battle of the Anoat Main Sensor Array|destroy]] Imperial [[Sensor array/Legends|Sensor array]] [[IOS 24]] and its [[Sensor Control]] station, allowing the [[Defiance Task Force|''Defiance'' task force]] to evade [[Corrupter Task Force|Imperial pursuit]].<ref name="X-wing Alliance" />

*Green Two - Ace Azzameen<ref name="X-wing Alliance" />
*Green Five - Olin Garn<ref name="X-wing Alliance" />
*Green Seven - Jorgis<ref name="X-wing Alliance" />

===Aboard ''Liberty''===
After the ''Defiance''{{'s}} escape, its flight crew were transferred to another [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruiser]], the [[Liberty/Legends|''Liberty'']], during its investigation of the Empire's [[TIE Experimental Project]]. A [[Flight group/Legends|flight group]] of twelve Green Group B-wings were scrambled in the [[MC80 Liberty Type Heavy Star Cruiser/Legends|Calamari Cruiser's]] [[Defense of the Liberty|defense]] from the prototype [[TIE series/Legends|TIEs]], and the group's B-wings, rejoined by Azzameen, retaliated with an [[Battle of Obsidian|assault]] on [[Obsidian (XQ1 Platform)|''Obsidian'']], the project's main research and production facility. The six&ndash;ship group<ref name="X-wing Alliance" /> suffered two losses, but destroyed the [[XQ1 Platform|facility platform]] and its [[Imperial Research Ship]] ''[[Sardis/Legends|Sardis]]'', ending the experimental TIE threat.<ref name="XWASG" />

A Green Squadron, flying Y-wing and later B-wing starfighters was stationed aboard the ''Liberty'' during [[Spreading the Rebellion|operations in the Airam sector]] as well as in the months leading up to the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].

*Green Two - Ace Azzameen<ref name="X-wing Alliance" />

===Battle of Endor===
By [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']] to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].</ref> Green Squadron, also known as Green Group<ref name="ROTJ" /> or Green Wing, consisted of top X-wing pilots assigned to fly [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|RZ-1 A-wing interceptors]]<ref name="CCGGSP">{{CCG|set=Death Star II Limited|cardname=Green Squadron Pilot}}</ref> as one of the Alliance's four main [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Battle group/Legends|battle groups]] at the Battle of Endor.<ref name="SWE">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

In that engagement, Green Squadron was assigned to defend Rebel [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]] from enemy [[Starfighter/Legends|fighters]] and [[Bomber/Legends|bombers]],<ref name="CCGGSA">{{CCG|set=Death Star II Limited|cardname=Green Squadron A-wing}}</ref> and upon discovery of the Imperial trap at [[Endor/Legends|Endor]], was ordered by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]] to stick close to holding sector MV-7 as the [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] took evasive action.<ref name="ROTJ" /> Squadron second-in-command<ref name="SWE" /> "[[Green Wing]]" was shot down and collided with the Imperial [[Pride of Tarlandia/Legends|main communications ship]],<ref name="ROTJn">[[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode VI: Return of the Jedi'' novel]]</ref> while Green Two [[Gemmer Sojan/Legends|Gemmer Sojan]] was credited with its destruction.<ref name="TEGW" />

Later in the battle, Green Squadron pilots including [[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu]] and [[Jake Farrell/Legends|Jake Farrell]]<ref name="RA">''[[Star Wars: Rebel Assault]]''</ref> followed [[Gold Leader/Legends|Gold Leader]] [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] and [[Red Leader/Legends|Red Leader]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] into the superstructure of the [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star]], with Celchu flying top cover for [[General/Legends|General]] Calrissian's [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']].<ref name="CCGGS3">{{CCG|set=Death Star II Limited|cardname=Green Squadron 3}}</ref> As the Rebels approached the [[Reactor/Legends|reactor core]], the A-wing pilots broke off on a run to the surface, hoping to draw the pursuing [[TIE series/Legends|TIE fighters]] away from Calrissian and Antilles.<ref name="ROTJ" /> Outside the Death Star, Farrell and Green Leader [[Arvel Crynyd/Legends|Arvel Crynyd]] disabled the [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]] of the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']].<ref name="TEGW" /> Crynyd rammed his A-wing into the ''Executor''{{'s}} unshielded [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]], resulting in the ship's destruction in a plunge towards the Death Star's surface.<ref name="ROTJ" />

*Green Leader - Arvel Crynyd
*Green Wing
*Green Two - Gemmer Sojan
*Green Three - Tycho Celchu<ref name="CCGGS3" />
*Green Four - Jake Farrell<ref name="TEGW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The [[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|''Star Wars: A New Hope'' novelization]] mentions a Green Squadron covering the squadron that would become the film's [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Squadron]]. Since only the novelization mentions Green and every other squadron's name changed from novel to film, it was uncertain for many years if that extra squadron was named Green. ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' finally referenced the Battle of Yavin's Green Squadron in [[2008]].
